title: Casement uPVC Windows
whatIsIt: A side-hinged window that opens outward like a door, sealed on all sides by a continuous compression gasket when closed.
whyChooseIt: The tightest seal of any window style, which is why it's the go-to choice for busy roads and noisy neighbourhoods — plus it can carry large fixed glass panels for an unbroken view.
idealFor: Homes facing busy or noisy streets
Rooms where you want the largest possible glass view

benefits.title: Tightest seal in the range
benefits.description: Twin gasket sealing on every edge minimises air and noise leakage.

benefits.title: Multi-point locking
benefits.description: Locks at 2–3 points around the sash for stronger, more even security.

benefits.title: Large glass panels
benefits.description: Supports large fixed panes alongside operable sashes for uninterrupted views.

designOptions: Single, double or triple sash configurations, with optional fixed panels combined alongside operable sashes.

series.tagline: Built for strength and large openings
series.description: Designed for strength with twin gasket sealing and multi-point locks. Supports large fixed glass panels and is well suited to noisy streets.
Engineered for small-to-medium openings in medium-rise buildings, delivering 100% opening capability where Inventa's larger reinforcement isn't required.
